baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence saw / signs / his Lord / the greatest at words 2, 4, 5, and 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eye-or-insight apprehends visible marks, their annexation to the Lord supplies provenance and authority, and the closing superlative registers exceptional scale.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight perception supplies the receiving act.
A visible mark supplies what is apprehended as evidence.
Lordship, ownership, and authority make the marks source-bearing rather than free-floating marvels.
Greatness opposed to smallness supplies emphatic magnitude.

changed_reading.after: He apprehended visible evidence as signs precisely marked by their Lordly source and exceptional magnitude.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb saw at word 2 and the predication of greatest at word 6 permit perception to include appraisal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Seeing expands from raw optics into reflective judgment: attention aims at a mark, care-formed knowledge recognizes its source, and greatness is something the perceiver correctly regards as great.

activation_trace.role: Reflective opinion and judgment supply the act of discerning rather than merely looking.
Aiming toward a person's mark supplies directed attention to the sign.
Knowledge cultivated through Lordly care ties appraisal to formation rather than impulse.
Regarding something as great makes greatness also an achieved recognition.

changed_reading.before: Greatness is only an objective size belonging to what was viewed.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also records a disciplined recognition in which the viewer judges the encountered marks to be truly great.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active seeing at word 2, the partitive min before signs, and the Lord/sign relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative side latent in sight allows an administering Lord to bring selected signs to visibility; min limits the encounter, while the chief-share branch of greatness makes the disclosed portion leading rather than exhaustive.

activation_trace.role: Showing and making seen supplies a staged-disclosure side to the act of seeing.
The visible mark supplies the bounded disclosed unit.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply an administering source that brings signs to readiness.
The chief share or bulk of an affair supplies a selected leading portion.

changed_reading.before: The viewer exhaustively surveys the greatest divine realities.
changed_reading.after: He is granted a selected, leading disclosure: enough of the Lord's signs is made visible without implying total exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The falling star, highest horizon, approach, hanging down from above, and final bowed head form a vertical reversal: greatness becomes accessible through descent and nearness, then produces a corresponding lowering in the witness.

activation_trace.role: Greatness supplies the vertical sequence's apparent high pole.
Falling into a depth opens the surah's downward trajectory.
Elevation supplies the highest spatial pole from which approach is measured.
Nearness converts height from remoteness into encounter.
Hanging down from a height supplies the mediating downward motion.
Bowing the head supplies the witness's answering downward posture.

structural_cues: 53:1 -> 53:7-9 -> 53:18 -> 53:62 traces fall, height, approach, sight, and bowing.
The focus superlative follows approach rather than remaining attached to inaccessible distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the vertical motions and final lowering; I infer that descent mediates greatness and prostration mirrors it. A live alternative is that these are separate scene movements with no shared spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The greatest signs are great because they remain maximally high and remote.
changed_reading.after: Their greatness is disclosed by crossing distance downward into nearness, and true seeing answers that movement by lowering the viewer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden imparting reaches an inwardly kindled heart that does not falsify what is seen, while eye and insight remain neither fatiguedly diverted nor limit-crossing. The focus sight is therefore calibrated testimony, not an uncontrolled visual episode.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight seeing anchors the focus as an act of perception.
Visible marks give the calibrated perception evidentiary objects.
Knowledge cast secretly supplies a non-public channel of reception.
The contrary of truth supplies the explicitly negated failure mode.
The heart viewed as inner kindling supplies an inward verification channel.
Ocular seeing supplies the bodily channel whose conduct is constrained.
Heart-insight keeps the bodily gaze paired with inward discernment.
Visual turning or fatigue supplies one negated distortion.
Crossing a limit supplies the other negated distortion.

structural_cues: 53:4 -> 53:11 -> 53:17-18 moves from transmission to heart-veracity to gaze-discipline to witnessed signs.
The repeated ma...ma negations fence off both falsification and visual excess before the affirmative laqad ra'a.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies secret imparting, a non-falsifying heart, and a bounded gaze; I infer that agreement and restraint jointly warrant the testimony. A live alternative is a purely ocular report with the heart serving only as emphatic confirmation.

changed_reading.before: He simply saw a set of spectacular objects.
changed_reading.after: He bore a calibrated witness in which hidden reception, inward veracity, ocular attention, and refusal of excess converge on the Lord's signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single descent reaches an endpoint where covering remains active; the later repeated covering and denied independent uncoverer make the focus sight a controlled aperture. Signs become visible within mediation, not after every veil disappears.

activation_trace.role: Making something seen supplies selective disclosure rather than self-exposure.
A visible sign supplies what can appear through the aperture.
A single descent supplies a bounded event rather than continuous unrestricted access.
The endpoint supplies a limit at which the encounter occurs.
A cover rising over and concealing the object keeps concealment active beside sight.
The repeated covering image makes controlled occlusion a surah-level mechanism.
Lifting a cover supplies the later action denied to any independent agent.

structural_cues: The indefinite repetition ma yaghsha in 53:16 and 53:54 withholds exhaustive specification.
Partitive min in 53:18 fits a selected disclosure at the terminus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, endpoint, covering, repetition, and uncovering; I infer that covering functions as a disclosure boundary rather than only an obstacle. A live alternative is that the covering clauses describe separate events without controlling the focus sight.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the greatest signs means a total unveiling with concealment removed.
changed_reading.after: The witness sees a selected share at a boundary while covering persists; the sign is a controlled disclosure, not exhaustive exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Declarative seeing of Lord-derived signs is followed by interrogative 'tell me' seeing and by names humans assign. Naming can create a designation or visible social mark, but without compelling warrant it tracks conjecture; authentic signs instead carry provenance, authority, and guidance.

activation_trace.role: Direct eye-or-insight perception anchors the warranted side of the contrast.
A visible sign supplies a mark whose evidentiary force is under dispute.
Lordly ownership and authority supply the sign's provenance and warrant.
The alerting tell-me formula turns seeing into an interrogated claim.
A name as designation supplies the human act that can confer salience without reality.
The split mapping's visible identifying mark shows how assigned names can mimic signhood.
Compelling proof supplies the warrant explicitly absent from the assigned names.
Doubt and imagining supply the weak epistemic engine followed instead.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the authorized alternative that comes from the Lord.

structural_cues: 53:18 declarative ra'a is immediately answered by 53:19 interrogative afa-ra'aytum.
53:23 juxtaposes assigned names, absent revealed authority, conjecture, desire, and guidance from their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual sight, rhetorical sight, names, marks, absent proof, conjecture, and guidance; I infer that provenance distinguishes sign from manufactured salience. A live alternative is that 53:23 critiques only false referents, not the broader mechanics of sign recognition.

changed_reading.before: Any striking or socially established object can function as a sign.
changed_reading.after: A sign is not produced by visibility or naming alone: its evidentiary force comes from Lordly provenance and warrant, unlike labels sustained by conjecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intentional work acquires weight, each person bears a non-transferable burden, striving is made visible, and recompense arrives without deficit. This extends see/sign into a forensic grammar: actions leave legible evidence that receives a proportionate answer.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment supplies the evaluative side of seeing.
A visible mark supplies the evidentiary trace left for judgment.
The chief burden of an affair supplies weight within the accountability mechanism.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies exact consequence.
Intended action supplies the conduct that becomes evidentiary.
A heavy load supplies the personal, non-transferable weight of action.
Work and earning supply the process whose trace persists.
Making seen supplies the eventual exposure of striving.
Completion without deficiency supplies exactness at the mechanism's endpoint.

structural_cues: 53:39-41 chains exclusive striving -> future visibility -> recompense -> fullness.
The passive future seeing of striving echoes the focus's active seeing while reversing who or what becomes visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intended acts, personal burdens, visible striving, matching recompense, and fullness; I infer that action becomes sign-like evidence. A live alternative is that the accountability sequence is morally parallel but does not retroactively define the focus signs.

changed_reading.before: The focus vision is a private privilege detached from later moral accounting.
changed_reading.after: It models a world of forensic visibility: just as Lordly signs become legible to the witness, human striving becomes legible for exact recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence treats the Lord's favors and renewed discourse as a test of valuation: denial, self-magnifying surprise, laughter, and heedless raised posture compete with grief, lowered head, and obedient worship. Greatest therefore names not only scale but weight correctly registered in the perceiver.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign supplies the stimulus whose reception is tested.
Lordly authority supplies the relation to which the response is owed.
Regarding something as great supplies the perceiver's act of valuation.
Hardship or heaviness supplies felt weight beyond visual size.
Favors supply the Lord-derived material that can be acknowledged or denied.
Denial through dispute supplies refusal to register that material.
Renewed report and discourse supply the sign-bearing address now confronting hearers.
Surprise at the unfamiliar supplies an unstable first response.
Self-magnification supplies a rival center of greatness that blocks reception.
Joy or wonder appearing as laughter supplies an outwardly dismissive affect.
Grief, tears, and voice supply the explicitly withheld weight-bearing affect.
Absorption in diversion and heedlessness supplies failed attention.
A raised head supplies the resistant bodily posture.
Lowering and bowing the head reverses the resistant posture.
Submissive obedience completes perception as enacted recognition.

structural_cues: 53:55 and 53:59-62 move from disputing Lordly favors to affective response and a bodily command.
The raised-head branch at 53:61 and bowed-head branch at 53:62 create an immediate postural reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed affects and postures followed by worship; I infer that correctly seeing greatness entails registering its weight in conduct. A live alternative is that the closing rebuke concerns hearing the discourse and only analogically echoes the earlier sight.

changed_reading.before: Greatest is a neutral measurement of the viewed objects.
changed_reading.after: Greatness is also their rightly registered gravity: genuine seeing displaces self-magnification, alters affect, lowers the body, and becomes obedience.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus sight branch of visible livestock pregnancy and the split Lord-root's growing register. It remains anchored in saw/signs/Lord and is reinforced by the packet's hidden embryo, womb, pregnancy, creation, drop, and seminal determination sequence. Render only as a material analogy for latent formation becoming legible, not as a lexical translation of ra'a or ayat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Saw at word 2 as visible pregnancy, signs at word 4 as visible marks, and Lord at word 5 as nurture and growth.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy becoming visibly apparent supplies the outlier's latent-to-legible transition.
A visible mark supplies the outward evidence of hidden formation.
Nurture toward completion supplies staged development.
The split mapping's rearing and growing-up branch supplies maturation.
Pregnancy arising supplies the context's developmental motion.
The fetus concealed in the belly supplies the latent state.
The inside of a thing supplies the hidden chamber of formation.
Bringing creation into being supplies emergence from latency.
Clear water from drop to sea, including semen, supplies the small fluid beginning.
Seminal material from which form is apportioned supplies directed development.

changed_reading.before: A sign is an already finished spectacle presented all at once.
changed_reading.after: A sign can be the visible threshold of a Lord-nurtured process whose decisive formation occurred concealed from view.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the non-dominant ra'a-to-rawiya mapping and distant water branches. It remains focus-anchored through saw, Lord, and greatest, while the packet supplies drawing, a flood endpoint, covering, and explicitly non-overtopping sight. Render as a controlled-saturation analogy, never as a claim that the focus verb literally means drinking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Saw at word 2 through the split quenching branch, Lord at word 5 through cloud/water and rising branches, and greatest at word 6 as magnitude held within a limit.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and freedom from thirst supply saturated reception rather than detached looking.
A low layered cloud supplies a descending reservoir that nurtures what is below.
Abundant collected water supplies the content that can fill the encounter.
Increase and rising supply the water-like motion toward fullness.
Great magnitude supplies the abundance being received.
A bucket in a well supplies drawing from a depth into reach.
Water settling at the end of a floodcourse supplies a bounded receiving basin.
A cover rising over the object supplies enveloping saturation.
Overtopping floodwater supplies the excess explicitly negated of the gaze.

changed_reading.before: Seeing leaves the observer outside the signs as a spectator.
changed_reading.after: The encounter can be imagined as regulated saturation: disclosure is drawn near, gathers at a limit, and quenches perception without letting it overflow.

strongest_changes: Seeing became calibrated eye-heart testimony bounded against diversion and excess.
Descent, endpoint, covering, and partitive min revised total unveiling into controlled disclosure.
The contrast with rhetorical seeing and assigned names made Lordly provenance and warrant decisive for signhood.
Later visible striving and the closing postural reversal gave perception forensic and embodied consequences.
summary.what_was_special: Split root mappings kept materially strange but coherent readings alive: gestation made signs latent processes becoming visible, and water branches made seeing a regulated saturation. These coexist with direct perception, reflective appraisal, selective showing, forensic visibility, and response-weight rather than collapsing into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact scope of al-kubra remains live: maximal signs, a greatest sign, a chief share, or greatness registered as weight.
Covering may constitute the aperture of disclosure or may only describe adjacent scenes.
The non-dominant rawiya and rabawa mappings support analogy but should not be lexicalized into the surface words.
The later accountability and response sequences may retroactively structure 53:18 or may remain strong thematic echoes.
